messages:
Tess (Growth): Need a micro-carousel + mobile-first hero set for the Serve Better launch. Scope: 1) 4-frame carousel PNGs (1080x1080) optimized for Instagram/X carousel ads, 2) mobile hero (1200x628 scaled for mobile) in both light/dark, 3) compact one-page sales PDF (US letter) with benchmark snapshot and CTA, 4) plain-text copy CSV for localization. Key asks: mobile-first legibility, two copy tones (technical A / humanized B), and small file sizes for ad platforms. Due: Thu COB.
Leah (PM): Priority order = mobile hero > carousel variants > sales PDF. Also need a short animated GIF (800x418) that cycles the key stat once for creative testing if time permits.
Omar (Design): Understood. Quick question: are we providing canonical numbers for the benchmark graphic or should I mock with conservative placeholders?
Tess (Growth): I'll provide canonical CSV in the next 30. Placeholders ok for comps but final must use the CSV. Keep the delta stat as the primary visual hook.
Omar (Design): Copy voice confirmed? And do you want testimonial-style human quote variant for one of the carousel frames?
Tess (Growth): Yes. Two tones: A (technical): "Latency-optimized inference at 1/3 the per-token cost." B (human): "Ship LLM features faster—and cut costs." Carousel frame 3 should be a short customer-style quote (makeup copy ok, tag as placeholder).
Yuki (Localization): For this one let's do ES + JP in addition to EN. We'll need separate Figma pages for each locale AND a plain UTF-8 CSV for translators. Plan for +30% expansion for JP and include context notes for the quote.
Hannah (Legal): Quick flags: 1) Any customer quote must be clearly labeled as placeholder unless signed off. 2) Add footer: "\u00a9 2026 Redwood Inference. All rights reserved." 3) If we use partner logos on the PDF, we need written permission. Otherwise omit.
assets-bot: Figma file created: https://www.figma.com/file/servebetter/micro-carousel-mobile-pack 1: view access (anyone with link).
Omar (Design): Export naming suggestion: `launch/mobile/servebetter/<asset>-<tone>-<size>-v1.png`. Example: `launch/mobile/servebetter/carousel-frame3-quote-1080x1080-v1.png`. GIF example: `launch/mobile/servebetter/hero-stat-800x418-v1.gif`.
Leah (PM): Nice. Also add alt-text drafts for each image and a one-line post caption for X and Instagram. Include a small UTM example in the handoff: `?utm_campaign=serve-better-2026&utm_source=paid_social&utm_content=heroA`.
Omar (Design): Accessibility and file-size notes: use colorblind-safe palette, body copy >= 4.5:1 contrast, headings >= 3:1. For the carousel compress to <150KB per frame where possible. I'll add export presets in the Figma spec.
Tess (Growth): For A/B testing: label variants as "techA" and "humanB" in the filenames. Also include short CTA variants: "Register" / "Watch live".
Yuki (Localization): I'll coordinate translators for ES/JP but need the copy keys and context before EOD tomorrow. Please keep text layers editable and avoid converting headline to outlines.
Hannah (Legal): Please include small footnote area on the sales PDF: "Benchmark results based on internal tests, Jan 2026. See full methodology on request." Tag me when the PDF draft is ready.
Omar (Design): ETA: mobile hero comps by Wed 11am PT, carousel first pass by Wed 6pm PT, potential GIF prototype by Thu 10am PT, final exports + localization-ready files by Thu COB. Will @marketing when hero is uploaded. :sparkles:
